list_tracks.description: Read every project in the history list: title, duration, project id, and whether it is ready.
steps: For each track_row: project id from track_link (last path segment), title from track_title, duration = first track_text matching m:ss.
Ready = download_button and more_button present and no track_busy inside the row.
list_tracks.evidence: Rows parsed with a non-empty title and project id; an empty list is only trusted when history_empty_state is shown.

generate_track.description: Generate music from one prompt with the configured model, lyrics off, and wait until the new tracks are ready.
preconditions: no existing track is still generating
steps: Select settings.music_model via music_model_button -> model_option (only if not already selected).
Turn lyrics_switch off (only if it is on).
Set the prompt with the Tiptap editor (setContent with promptRegion + empty lyricsRegion); verify prompt_region text.
Re-check model, lyrics, prompt, Generate enabled and not loading; then click generate_button once.
Wait for expected_tracks new ready rows (title + duration) and a stable set for 8 s.
generate_track.evidence: expected_tracks new project ids appear, all ready with title and duration, and generate_button is no longer loading.
generate_track.retry: never - an uncertain Generate is not repeated; the run stops and reports

download_track.description: Download one project as MP3 into the session folder and verify the file.
steps: Find the row by project id (never by index) and its download_button; click it (trusted CDP).
In the open_menu labelled by that button, click mp3_menu_item.
If a CDP click was acknowledged but nothing opened, call the element's live React handler instead (same element, re-checked).
Wait for a new .mp3 whose name starts with the title (session folder first, then ~/Downloads); move/rename it into @downloads/<date>-sessionN/.
download_track.evidence: Local file >= settings.min_audio_bytes, valid audio header (ID3 / MPEG frame / RIFF-WAVE / OggS), and duration within settings.duration_tolerance_s of the online duration (ffprobe).
download_track.retry: the download click may be repeated only after confirming no new file arrived

delete_track.description: Delete one project from ElevenLabs - only after its local MP3 is verified.

inputs.title: required
inputs.local_file: verified MP3 whose name matches the title

preconditions: file name matches the project title
steps: Find the row by project id; re-read its title and abort if it changed.
Click more_button -> delete_menu_item in the menu labelled by that button.
In the dialog whose text contains Delete "<title>", click delete_confirm_button.
Wait until the project link is gone, reload history, and wait until the list has loaded again.
delete_track.evidence: After reloading history the project id is absent and the list loaded (count >= previous - 1, or history_empty_state shown).
delete_track.retry: never repeat a confirm click; an unfinished delete is cancelled (cancel_button) and the page reloaded
